trees.notes: The divisible pool is not published as its own line, but it follows from two figures that are: devolution is a fixed percentage of it, so dividing back out recovers it. What is left is the cess and surcharge states get no share of.

notes: The denominator that turns a national devolution total into a share of tax collected. Gross tax revenue is what the Union collected before anything is devolved or spent; it is a receipts figure, which is why it lives outside the expenditure dataset.
